_comment: Google Antigravity MCP config. Add via Antigravity Settings -> MCP -> Add server (or paste into its mcp_config.json). Connects through agentgateway (governance + audit logging in front of the MCP server) via the 'mcp-remote' bridge (npx), since native remote/http MCP server support isn't confirmed for Antigravity. Start, in order: Data API (uvicorn data_api.main:app --port 8000), then agentgateway (backend/mcp_server/gateway/ — see README 'agentgateway'). Requires Node/npx on PATH.
